newsitem.title: USA: FOREST OIL SETS PANEL TO EYE UNIT'S VALUE.
newsitem.headline: FOREST OIL SETS PANEL TO EYE UNIT'S VALUE.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Monday its Saxon Petroleum Inc unit, 65 percent-owned by Forest Oil, formed a special committee of independent directors to improve shareholder value.
The committee will assess the asset base of Saxon and determine strategic alternatives.

Forest Oil owns about 90 million Saxon common shares, warrants to purchase an additional 5.3 million shares at C$0.55 per share and rights to purchase 5.4 million shares at an average price of C$0.57 per share.
Forest Oil said it could be a purchaser or a seller in any transaction which results from the assessment made by the special committee.
